agyos_skill.intent: Use when setting up freelance financial tracking, invoicing, international payment routes, drafting legal contracts (NDAs, master service agreements), configuring CRM/automation stacks, managing developer time, or designing scaling models.
agyos_skill.instructions: Run your freelance practice like a lean, profitable business — not a chaotic side-hustle. This module covers the financial, legal, and operational infrastructure that keeps revenue flowing, risk controlled, time protected, and growth systematic. To utilize this skill's financial sheets, legal templates, or tool checklists, read the corresponding document in the `references/` directory: | File | Focus | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | [06A-FINANCE-TRACKING.md](references/06A-FINANCE-TRACKING.md) | Finance & Invoicing | Dedicated business banking setup, Wise/Payoneer setup, invoicing fields, international payment routes, tax reserves, expense tracking spreadsheet structure | | [06B-LEGAL-CONTRACTS.md](references/06B-LEGAL-CONTRACTS.md) | Legal & Contracts | 12 essential contract clauses, IP assignment, NDA terms, non-solicitation, payment penalty terms, governing law selection | | [06C-AUTOMATION-STACK.md](references/06C-AUTOMATION-STACK.md) | Automation Stack | Zero-maintenance CRM design, Zapier/Make/n8n comparison, AI-assisted lead parsing and onboarding automations | | [06D-TIME-MANAGEMENT.md](references/06D-TIME-MANAGEMENT.md) | Time Management | Deep work architecture, calendar blocking, IST/global time zone scheduling, asynchronous communication boundary scripts | | [06E-SCALING-SYSTEMS.md](references/06E-SCALING-SYSTEMS.md) | Scaling Systems | Productized service design, premium retainer models, digital products, hiring sub-contractors, solo-to-agency flywheel | When asked to set up or audit a freelancer's financial workflow: - Reference [06A-FINANCE-TRACKING.md](references/06A-FINANCE-TRACKING.md) to split incoming revenue: 30% for taxes, 20% for business development, 50% for owner salary/expenses. - Guide the freelancer to set up Wise or Payoneer for international client transactions to minimize conversion fees. - Design clean invoices containing all legally required fields. When drafting or reviewing client contracts: - Reference [06B-LEGAL-CONTRACTS.md](references/06B-LEGAL-CONTRACTS.md) to verify that the contract includes the **12 Essential Clauses** (IP Assignment upon final payment, late payment penalties, clear termination terms, and governing jurisdiction). - Advise on NDA boundaries to protect the freelancer's background IP (boilerplates, reusable utilities). When designing an automated admin workflow: - Reference [06C-AUTOMATION-STACK.md](references/06C-AUTOMATION-STACK.md) to choose the correct automation framework (Zapier, Make, or self-hosted n8n). - Set up the **CRM Lead Capture Engine**: Typeform/Cal.com $\rightarrow$ n8n/Zapier $\rightarrow$ Slack $\rightarrow$ Airtable. When auditing calendar schedules or time-management practices: - Reference [06D-TIME-MANAGEMENT.md](references/06D-TIME-MANAGEMENT.md) to structure a calendar using **Deep Work Architecture** (blocking 3-4 hour uninterrupted periods for coding, separating client calls to specific afternoons). - Formulate async-first email or Slack boundaries to block constant client interruptions. When asked to scale operations, raise prices, or hire team members: - Reference [06E-SCALING-SYSTEMS.md](references/06E-SCALING-SYSTEMS.md) to productize complex services (e.g., "ML model audit for $2,500" with a fixed scope, clear inputs, and standardized outputs). - Structure sub-contracting agreements to delegate basic tasks while preserving quality control.
